latest_release.name: Tinycast 0.12.11
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Trust updates through a release key or the running identity, and install them at quit by @abue-ammar in #1808
* Replace the update window with a pill in the palette by @abue-ammar in #1817
* Fix Toggle System Appearance toast always saying Light Appearance by @charmcity-code in #1806
* Calculator: natural-language dates, zoned times, compound rates, split bills by @Kaloyanes in #1771
* Fix text area crash from SwiftUI's unbounded width probe by @abue-ammar in #1818
* Honour file descriptors in spawn's stdio by @abue-ammar in #1822
* Calculator: unit fractions, rounding, interest, date spans and more phrases by @abue-ammar in #1823
* Show Settings, AI Chat and command-output menus in a fullscreen Space by @abue-ammar in #1828
* Fix floating Notes window not dragging by its title bar by @abue-ammar in #1829
* Reasoning effort picker for the OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini APIs by @abue-ammar in #1830
* Add chat presets: start an AI Chat from saved instructions, model and tools by @abue-ammar in #1796
* Convert currency pairs without a connector by @edalzell in #1831
* Let the palette's Liquid Glass own its rounded corner by @abue-ammar in #1835
* Install from homebrew/cask; the tap keeps only the universal build by @abue-ammar in #1836
* Clip the ⌘K menu in SwiftUI and restore the panel scrim by @abue-ammar in #1839
* Restore Form fields that set storeValue by @abue-ammar in #1841
* Serve exchange rates from tinycast.dev by @abue-ammar in #1842
* Lay out bilingual dictionary entries by @abue-ammar in #1843
* Sharpen the palette corner and reopen compact after a restore by @abue-ammar in #1844
* Draw the compact bar on the expanded panel's glass by @abue-ammar in #1845
* Revert "Draw the compact bar on the expanded panel's glass" by @abue-ammar in #1846

## New Contributors
* @charmcity-code made their first contribution in #1806
* @Kaloyanes made their first contribution in #1771
* @edalzell made their first contribution in #1831

<!-- tinycast:install -->

**Channel:** stable · **Version:** 0.12.11 · **Bundle ID:** `com.tinycast.app`
Built from 58168bf7e0b721f7c5fbfc7f4e8a068a48cff446. [Full changelog](https://github.com/abue-ammar/tinycast/compare/v0.12.8...v0.12.11)

Install via Homebrew, or open the DMG below and drag Tinycast to Applications:
```sh
brew install --cask tinycast
```
